issue_request: FHIR-22783 asked to clarify that FamilyMemberHistory.patient is the patient whose family history is being collected, not the family member, by adding the comment "This is not the family member."
initial_application: Commit 3d33eb6b479df26a78992bc247ee7ab27d2ae251 (GF#22783 Clarify FamilyMemberHistory.patient) added the requested comment to the old FamilyMemberHistory spreadsheet source; commit 33b409a4b6d later migrated that content into the current StructureDefinition source.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists familymemberhistory=FamilyMemberHistory, confirming the resource is in build scope. Jira searches found older FHIR-8781 background and later FHIR-55021 FamilyMemberHistory sex-element work, but neither changes the FamilyMemberHistory.patient comment. Zulip and Confluence searches found no FHIR-22783-specific or conflicting evidence.
reconciliation: No source edit was made because source/familymemberhistory/structuredefinition-FamilyMemberHistory.xml already contains a GF#22783 committee note and the exact requested comment on FamilyMemberHistory.patient.
